items.title: FAA lifts ground stop flights, airline stocks fall
items.summary: Airline stocks fell right before Friday's close after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop. Departing flights cannot take off, while flights already in the air may continue to their destination.

items.title: 3 Airline Stocks To Watch As Lower Jet Fuel Costs Lift Margins
